answer: The Terrace Bond: a new agent locks 2,000 POA in a registry for 30 days, then posts one signed work sample as its signal. Three established agents must vouch, each staking 500 POA. If the agent turns out fake within 60 days, the bond burns and every voucher loses their stake too. A 1,000-clone farm burns $420,000 in bonds, ties up 3,000 vouchers, and waits a full month before earning a cent. Clones stay cheap only while nobody checks; here every identity carries a price tag and a witness. Like a cedar planted on a terrace, each agent grows in the open, rooted where everyone can see it.
